// ConnectionStrings: Company Oracle (mill4db). WARNING: this file is committed, so the password travels with the code. Before pushing to a shared or public repository, remove it from here and set the ConnectionStrings__Crm04 environment variable on the server instead - an environment variable overrides this value.

Source.// Kind: OpcUa - the plant feed. REQUIRED: an unset or unrecognised value refuses to start. 'Replay' (simulator output) is refused outside Development.

OpcUa.// MappingFile: Plant address -> twin tag. Defaults to dotnet/config/tag_mapping.csv.
OpcUa.// StaleAfterMs: Stop writing frames when no plant value has arrived for this long, so an outage shows as STALE rather than as frozen readings stamped current.
OpcUa.// NodeIdPrefix: Prepended to each PlantAddress in tag_mapping.csv to form the OPC UA NodeId. On this plant the Kepware tag names ARE the MillPilot addresses, so the NodeId is ns=2;s=<address>. The Feeder logs every NodeId Kepware rejects.
OpcUa.// Username: null = anonymous login (this plant's Kepware setting). For a named user, put the name here and the password in the OpcUa__Password environment variable.
OpcUa.// UseSecurity: false = OPC UA security policy None (this plant's Kepware endpoint). true = Basic256Sha256 Sign & Encrypt, which needs certificate trust in both directions.
OpcUa.// AutoAcceptServerCertificate: Only matters with UseSecurity=true. Leave false once Kepware's certificate has been placed in pki/trusted.

Retention.// Hours: How much TAG_SAMPLE history to keep. At 1,080 rows/s, 2 hours is ~7.8M rows / ~310 MB and stays flat. Retention drops whole partitions, so raising this costs storage but no run-time work.
